changelog:
Initial release of openclaw-auto-doctor—your automated OpenClaw operations assistant.

- Real-time log monitoring and error detection for OpenClaw.
- Automatic error diagnosis with extraction of error type, message, location, and context.
- Multi-channel intelligent search for solutions (local database, GitHub Issues/PRs, community, docs).
- Supports automatic fixes (dependency install, config changes, permission fixes, service management, code patches) with backup and rollback mechanisms.
- Creates Pull Requests with suggested fixes when issues cannot be auto-resolved.
- Configurable options for monitored log paths, GitHub repo, and auto-fix behavior.
- All operations are transparent, user-controlled, and prioritize safety.
summary: 实时监控 OpenClaw 日志，自动诊断错误，搜索解决方案，并自动修复问题或创建 Pull Request
